Sam L: Quick sync — we need to lock the feedback cadence for the Field Prop pilot (Acme, Harbor, Sierra). Goal: capture post-demo reactions + 2-week usage sentiment. Who can own outreach?
Priya K: I can own outreach and the 15-min surveys. Planning to run a short pulse next Tue/Wed. Will need final participant list by EOD Fri.
Luis M: I can add two product probes to the survey re: latency and hallucination frequency. Short, 3 questions.
Nora C: I'll prep an enablement doc and 30-min walkthrough deck. Can host office hours the week after pulses.
Sam L: Perfect. Priya — can you draft the invite language? Keep it non-technical for Acme, slightly more technical for Harbor/Sierra.
Priya K: Draft below — please thumbs up / small edits.
Priya K: ```Hey — thanks for joining the Field Prop pilot. Quick favor: 2-min survey after your demo helps us prioritize fixes. No sales follow-up — just product feedback. Pick a 15-min slot for a quick follow-up: <cal link>```
Luis M: +1. I'll append: "If you see responses that look like hallucinations, paste one example in the free text so we can triage."
Nora C: For enablement deck: can someone confirm which model variant each customer is on? I have notes but want to avoid sending wrong instructions.
Sam L: Acme = redwood-v1-small, Harbor = redwood-v1-medium (quantized), Sierra = redwood-v2-alpha. Sierra has low usage so renewal risk flag — we should prioritize their walkthrough.
Priya K: Noted re: Sierra. I'll bump them to high-touch. Also creating a short optional checklist for CSMs:
Priya K: ```- Confirm model variant
- Share quick start link: https://redwood.example/field-prop-quickstart
- Push survey after demo (link)
- Schedule office hours if low usage
```
Sam L: Timeline: finalize invites by Fri, pulse runs Tue/Wed, product triage Wed afternoon, office hours Thurs/Fri. Is that feasible?
Luis M: Feasible. Will block Wed 3–4pm for triage. Please add any triage repros to this thread or the "field-prop-triage" board.
Nora C: I'll schedule office hours Thu 10am & Fri 2pm PT and add Zoom links to the invite.
OnboardingBot: Reminder: pilot-survey-template v2 saved to /docs/pilots/survey-v2.md (auto).
Sam L: One more ask — can we capture a usage snapshot before the pulse? Priya, can you run a one-off token/active-users export?
Priya K: Yup. I'll export and drop a quick CSV in the drive by Mon noon.
Sam L: Thanks all. I'll send a recap to the account execs and include renewal-risk note for Sierra. Ping here if anything slips. :thumbsup:
